sources.says: In 2011 Tajikistan ratified the 1999 deal and 2002 supplement ceding about 200 and 1,122 km² in the Pamirs to China.

unresolved.why: Treaties with Kazakhstan (1994, ratified 1995; protocol 2002), Kyrgyzstan (1996/1999, finalised 2009) and Tajikistan (1999/2002, ratified 2011) moved land to Xinjiang. NE keeps the Soviet-era lines: about 877+150 km² of the Tajik cession and pieces near Lake Zhalanashkol and Uzengi-Kush lie in NE neighbour atoms. Exact entry-into-force days were not established.
checked: NE ca96624 vs OSM relation 270056 (polygon difference; TJK-366 land OSM gives China 877 km² at 74.46E 38.48N)

unresolved.why: Every layout before the 1979 restoration of Inner Mongolia differs from the NE atoms along lines inside them: 1949–54 greater regions and abolished provinces (Chahar, Pingyuan, Suiyuan, Songjiang, Liaodong/Liaoxi, Rehe, Xikang, Ningxia Province), 1950–52 Sichuan and North/South Jiangsu/Anhui districts, Beijing/Shanghai/Tianjin county transfers 1958 and 1973, Qinzhou between Guangdong and Guangxi 1951–1965, the Inner Mongolia split 1969–79, and many county transfers. No complete pre-1978 annual change record was reachable to prove any unit unchanged before 1979.
checked: xzqh.org annual pages exist only from 1978
